name: Words
author: jandragsbaek
description: Word counts from actual keystrokes, per window and site, with live WPM, goals, and git-style diffs.

barWidget.description: Word counts from real typing, with live WPM and configurable goals

schema.label: Daily word goal
schema.description: Net words to hit each day for the primary match.

schema.label: Goal match
schema.description: What to count: a Hyprland class (obsidian), browser site (site:x), herdr workspace (herdr:grok build), activity (activity:grok · grok build), Hyprland workspace (ws:2), or all.

schema.label: Goal app class (legacy)
schema.description: Used if Goal match is empty. Prefer Goal match.

schema.label: Extra goals (JSON)
schema.description: Optional JSON array of {match, words, label} for multiple targets. When set, this list is the full set of goals.

schema.label: Daily note path
schema.description: Obsidian daily-note path. Tokens: {date} {yyyy} {MM} {dd}. Empty disables auto-write.

schema.label: Update daily note
schema.description: Rewrite the marked section in today's daily note as you type.
